titulo.alumno:
«Косвенный вопрос с ли»
Indirect question with ли

intro: In an indirect yes/no question, ли appears after the verb: Я не знаю, придёт ли он.

frases.alumno: She asked whether the room was free.

frases.estudio: Я не знаю, успеет ли поезд.
frases.alumno: I do not know whether the train will arrive on time.

piezas.titulo: In an indirect yes/no question, ли appears after the verb: Я не знаю, придёт ли он.
texto: In an indirect yes/no question, ли appears after the verb: Я не знаю, придёт ли он.
The indirect question is built into the sentence and is normally separated with a comma; it does not keep the direct question order.

pregunta.texto: Which word marks an indirect yes/no question here?

opciones.explicacion: ли goes after the verb and expresses the yes/no alternative.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Она спросила, свободен ли кабинет.»

opciones.texto: She asked whether the room was free.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: I do not know whether the train will arrive on time.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Я не знаю, успеет ли поезд

piezas.traduccion: I do not know whether the train will arrive on time.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
